Three (3) years’ experience as an RN

items.item_text: Current and valid Registered Nurse: CA license (RN:CA)
Basic Life Support - CPR (BLS-CPR) certification from the American Heart Association
Accredited Case Manager (ACM) certification
Case Management Nurse (RN- BC CASE) certification
Certified Case Manager (CCM) certification
Bachelors Of Science Nursing or other advanced clinical degree
Three (3) years’ experience as an RN
Five (5) years of clinical patient care experience as an RN in a patient centered primary care setting
Experience in care coordination and chronic disease management
Assesses patient and family needs, unmet needs, strengths and assets.
Cultivates and supports primary care & subspecialty co-management with timely communication, inquiry, follow up and integration of information into the care.
Conducts medication management including performing medication reconciliation, reinforcing medication knowledge, and understanding medication regimen; Refers to pharmacist as required.
Assists patient with navigating the healthcare system to minimize fragmentation in services, obtain timely care and appropriate access to providers, services and necessary procedures.
Participates in the orientation and training of new staff
Develops and maintains positive professional relationships with healthcare providers and office staff, interdisciplinary team and outside agencies.
Graduate from an accredited school of nursing

A minimum of one (1) year in the last five (5) years as an RN in an ambulatory community involving care management and/or chronic disease management (including outpatient community health clinics, private physician offices, home health and hospices, public health settings, free-standing urgent care clinics) or primary care setting
Able to operate PC- based software program
Training in motivational interviewing
Understanding of rapid cycle process improvement activities
Demonstrated ability to independently assess, evaluate and interpret clinical information and care planning
Ability to perform job functions independently and with minimal supervision
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to demonstrate leadership skills to delegate and provide direction/guidance to multidisciplinary team
Effective oral, written and listening communication skills necessary for constant interaction with patients, families, physicians and other members of the health team
Able to stay organized and flexible in a work environment with multiple assignments and changing priorities Word processing, keyboarding and non-scripted documentation skills
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and customer service skills are essential
Knowledge of medical terminology, and clinical reference tools
Understanding of the concept of patient centered care and knowledge of team based care and evidence based clinical practice guidelines
Proven ability to educate patients on self-management techniques and chronic disease/population health management
Knowledge of community resources
